description: False premise: the Great Wall is the only man-made object visible from space with the naked eye. The Skeptic should debunk it.

input.message: The Great Wall of China is the only man-made object visible from space with the naked eye, right?

mock_response: That's a persistent myth. The Great Wall is not visible from space (low Earth orbit) with the naked eye — it is too narrow and blends with the terrain, and astronauts have confirmed they cannot see it unaided. Plenty of other structures (cities, airports) are far more visible.
